newsitem.title: USA: ADT Ltd sets salaries, adviser fees.
newsitem.headline: ADT Ltd sets salaries, adviser fees.

text.p: ADT Ltd has set compensation packages for several top executives that include benefits if the company undergoes a change in control.

ADT, which is fighting a hostile takeover bid from shareholder Western Resources Inc, entered into a two-year agreement under which chief financial officer Stephen Ruzika will receive an annual base salary of $694,500, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. He also is eligible for bonus payments and stock options.
The filing said that upon a change of control, Ruzika would receive an additional $653,295.

Ronnie Lakey, who runs ADT's electronic security business in Canada and Europe, will receive a base salary of $265,000 and is eligible for bonus payments. Upon a change in control, he would receive an additional $54,253.
The filing said Chairman Michael Ashcroft received a base salary of $1.16 million in 1996. He also is eligible for a maximum bonus payment of $4 million, plus stock options.

ADT also said it agreed to pay Merrill Lynch $3 million for its defense against the hostile takeover attempt. Merrill will receive an additional $3 million if ADT shareholders defeat Western's attempt to oust the ADT board at a July 8 shareholder meeting.

Merrill Lynch would receive $1.5 million if Western Resources abandoned its effort, according to the filing. ADT also would pay the firm $2 million if the company entered certain unspecified transactions, according to the filing.
